title: 第10章 气功师
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哦耶，太好了，我觉醒锻造师天赋了！”

陆小小从睡梦中醒过来，欣喜地跳了起来。

一时间。

风起云涌！

周围女生们纷纷围上来，七嘴八舌地问她怎么觉醒的。

九个女生中，之前明确觉醒天赋的只有苏青青一人，现在陆小小也觉醒了，大家在开心的同时又有些羡慕。

陆小小认真思考着说道：“我也不是很清楚，刚才我在睡觉，感觉有股强大力量充满了我的身体——”

话音未落，所有人的目光齐刷刷转向秦守。

刚才大家都看到了，陆小小睡在了秦守身边。

所以，强大的力量是……

秦守满头黑线。

虽然他没证据，但他有理由怀疑陆小小在开车。

“刚才的事情我都看见了。”

姜瑶站出来替他解围，耳尖还泛着一层极淡的粉色。

“小小自己睡觉不老实，滚到了秦守身边。她是碰到了秦守手上的初级天赋石，才觉醒的天赋。”

她说着指了指地上那颗已经碎掉的石头，又看向秦守手中剩下那颗。

众女也纷纷看向秦守手中的天赋石，淡金色的光晕在石头的纹路里缓缓流动，属性面板清晰可见。

【初级天赋石：可开发天赋，解锁特殊能力。每名玩家限用一颗。】

“还剩最后一颗。”秦守把天赋石拿了出来，说道：“我已经用过了，这颗给你们。”

车厢里安静了一瞬，随即炸开了锅。

陆小小喊道：“秦守，你太大方，太好了！我决定报答你——就让雪儿再亲你一口！”

顾佳佳道：“小小，你别胡闹了，你要报答秦守，凭什么让雪儿亲秦守？”

陆小小气鼓鼓：“佳佳，我们是好姐妹，你怎么不帮我说话？”

顾佳佳俏脸一红：“小小，我觉得你这么做不合适，你要考虑人家雪儿的感受，如果你非要找人亲秦守，其实——其实我也可以！”

陆小小被震惊到了，满脸不敢置信。

“啊，佳佳，你在说什么呀？”

顾佳佳俏脸羞红，却还是忍不住偷眼瞥向秦守。

天知道以她羞涩的小性格，说出这一番大胆的话，消耗了多大的勇气？

顾佳佳在心中为自己鼓劲加油。

“佳佳，你可以的，为了完成系统任务，你一定可以！只要完成多子多福系统任务，你就能变强，你就能保护大家……”

姜瑶看了看顾佳佳，又看了看秦守。

总觉得哪里怪怪的。

顾佳佳的性格内敛害羞。

今天怎么表现得这么“奔放大胆”？

应该是错觉吧。

姜瑶在心中摇了摇头。

她现在也有点心虚。

毕竟她也“不干净”。

她刚才的话里有个致命的漏洞。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Oh yeah, great, I've awakened my blacksmith talent!"

Lu Xiaoxiao woke up from his sleep and jumped up with joy.

For a while.

The storm is rising!

The girls around her gathered around her and asked her how she woke up.

Among the nine girls, only Su Qingqing had clearly awakened her talent before. Now Lu Xiaoxiao has also awakened, and everyone is happy and a little envious at the same time.

Lu Xiaoxiao thought seriously and said, "I'm not sure. I was sleeping just now and I felt a powerful force filling my body -"

Before he finished speaking, everyone's eyes turned to Qin Shou.

Everyone saw just now that Lu Xiaoxiao was sleeping next to Qin Shou.

So, the powerful force is...

Qin Shou's head was full of black lines.

Although he had no evidence, he had reason to suspect that Lu Xiaoxiao was driving.

"I saw everything that just happened."

Jiang Yao stood up to help him, her ears still glowing with a very light pink color.

"Xiao Xiao didn't sleep well and rolled over to Qin Shou. She only awakened her talent when she encountered the elementary talent stone in Qin Shou's hand."

As she spoke, she pointed to the broken stone on the ground, and then looked at the remaining stone in Qin Shou's hand.

The girls also looked at the talent stone in Qin Shou's hand. The light golden halo slowly flowed in the veins of the stone, and the attribute panel was clearly visible.

[Elementary talent stone: can develop talents and unlock special abilities.Limit one per player.】

"There is one last one left." Qin Shou took out the talent stone and said, "I have already used it, this one is for you."

The carriage was quiet for a moment, then exploded.

Lu Xiaoxiao shouted: "Qin Shou, you are so generous and so kind! I decided to repay you by letting Xue'er kiss you again!"

Gu Jiajia said: "Xiaoxiao, stop messing around. You want to repay Qin Shou. Why should Xueer kiss Qin Shou?"

Lu Xiao was stingy: "Jiajia, we are good sisters, why don't you speak for me?"

Gu Jiajia blushed: "Xiaoxiao, I don't think it's appropriate for you to do this. You have to consider Xue'er's feelings. If you insist on finding someone to kiss Qin Shou, actually - I can do it too!"

Lu Xiaoxiao was shocked, his face full of disbelief.

"Ah, Jiajia, what are you talking about?"

Gu Jiajia's face turned red with embarrassment, but she couldn't help but glance at Qin Shou secretly.

God knows how much courage it took for her shy little character to say such bold words?

Gu Jiajia encouraged herself in her heart.

"Jiajia, you can do it. In order to complete the system tasks, you must be able to do it! As long as you complete the system tasks of having many children and many blessings, you can become stronger and you can protect everyone..."

Jiang Yao looked at Gu Jiajia and then at Qin Shou.

I always feel like something is weird.

Gu Jiajia has a reserved and shy personality.

Why are you acting so "unrestrained and bold" today?

It must be an illusion.

Jiang Yao shook her head in her heart.

She also feels a little guilty now.

After all, she is "dirty" too.

There was a fatal flaw in what she just said.
